title: Last night, Apple briefly removed Telegram from the App Store because a single user had planted illegal pornographic content in a public gro
snippet:
Last night, Apple briefly removed Telegram from the App Store because a single user had planted illegal pornographic content in a public group chat.

⬅️ Telegram was restored within hours. But I want to explain what happened — to warn other app developers and help protect online communities from similar attacks.

🧹Because Telegram quickly removes illegal content from public groups using all kinds of moderation tools, the attacker had to resort to a technical trick. He inserted AI-modified illegal content by editing an old message in an active group chat. As a result, the content was effectively hidden from the group’s members, preventing them from seeing and promptly reporting it.

Gasoline-only vehicles made up 49% of global new-vehicle sales in the first half of 2026, down from 73% in 2021, according to Mobility Global data first reported by Nikkei. It’s the first time on record that they’ve been under half. But there’s a catch: most of the cars taking their place still have a gas tank. more…

title: India roundup: AI data center buildout accelerates as semiconductor push continues to broaden
snippet: India's technology buildout is deepening across semiconductors and AI infrastructure, with chip IP, packaging and equipment initiatives advancing alongside data center expansion, high-density computing, optical connectivity and GPU deployments.

title: Largan shifts new plant to FAU production as smartphone orders soften
snippet: Largan Technology said on October 8 that demand for new smartphone models weakened in September and that its newly completed automated plant will be used entirely for fiber array units, or FAUs, for co-packaged optics applications. The optical lens maker said the move comes as customers are asking it to deliver the finished FAU product directly.

title: AI doubles Aker differential oscillator mix; 312.5MHz sample set for 4Q26
snippet: Aker Technology said AI and electric vehicle demand are driving faster shipments, with automotive products accounting for 51.88% of sales in the first half of 2026. The quartz component maker also said its 312.5MHz product is scheduled to sample in the fourth quarter of 2026.

title: Episil chairman says SiC is not yet shifting from 6-inch to 8-inch
snippet: Episil held an earnings call on October 7, saying silicon carbide (SiC) capacity utilization has rebounded quickly from 30% at a low point to nearly 90% now. If 6-inch order demand keeps rising in 2027, the company will add capacity through 8-inch production. That has raised questions over whether the industry is entering a new wafer-size transition and whether 6-inch wafers are being phased out.

title: MAtek September 2026 revenue hits record for 7th straight month
snippet: MAtek, a leading semiconductor testing company, reported September 2026 revenue of NT$569 million (approx. US$17.8 million), up 12.31% year-over-year. Revenue for the first nine months reached NT$4.765 billion, rising 16.99% year-over-year, while third-quarter revenue climbed 16.14% year-over-year to NT$1.697 billion, a record for the period.

title: Baso Optical eyes steady performance in 2027 with focus on high-margin AOI, semiconductor, aerospace applications
snippet: Baso Precision Optics held its latest online earnings call on October 7, during which the company acknowledged short-term pressures on its gross margin, due to ongoing adjustments to its product mix, resulting in higher upfront costs and initial production yields that could still see improvement. Looking ahead to 2027, the company expects generally stable revenue and gross margin, with potential for additional growth depending on the validation of new products or pilot production breakthroughs i

title: Neweb Information lifts 2Q26 net profit 118% on IT upgrade demand
snippet: System integration provider Neweb Information, which is set to list on October 23, reported September 2026 revenue of NT$77.02 million (approx. US$2.41 million), up 33.48% year-over-year, as demand rose for enterprise core system replacements, network and cybersecurity upgrades, and AI infrastructure.

title: ICT inflation impact limited as supply shock falls short
snippet: Prices for electronic components such as memory, advanced copper foil, glass fiber cloth, and ABF substrates have been rising for some time as makers pass on costs amid tight supply. For the US, even if Apple raises retail prices for its core products, the impact on the Consumer Price Index (CPI) is limited and the supply-side shock has been less severe than expected.

title: DIGITIMES Insight: Why AI is shifting telecom traffic to the uplink
snippet: AI is changing the logic of telecom traffic growth, with Ericsson and industry researchers warning that mobile networks must now handle not only more data, but also more uplink traffic, real-time interaction, and connected-on-the-move usage. As generative AI, agentic AI, and multimodal interactions spread, telecom operators are being pushed to rethink network investment beyond downlink capacity.

title: Winmate rolls out rugged edge AI platform for drones, robotics
snippet: Winmate posted September 2026 revenue of NT$535 million (approx. US$16.8 million), up 31.8% month-on-month and 95.9% year-on-year, driven by strong end-market demand in defense, semiconductors, and edge AI. The industrial PC maker said robust orders in those segments are powering sales growth and expects overall operations to hit another record in 2027.

title: Nanya Plastics deepens push into power engineering as AI infrastructure demand rises
snippet: Nanya Plastics Corporation is expanding into heavy electrical equipment and power engineering, a move that could ripple beyond Taiwan as global demand for AI data centers, grid upgrades, and energy transition projects rises. The company's strategy signals growing competition in a sector increasingly critical to digital infrastructure worldwide.
